title: digestome: a licence-clean marker-gene panel for functional profiling of anaerobic digestion microbiomes
description:
A curated marker-gene panel and scorer for anaerobic digestion (AD) microbiomes, built only on sources that are free for commercial use: NCBIfam (public domain), Pfam (CC0) and Rhea (CC BY). No KEGG or MetaCyc licence is needed at any stage, which is what makes fee-for-service analysis for biogas operators possible.

The scorer reports module completeness, branch capability and, for hydrolysis, whether an enzyme carries a domain that anchors it outside the cell, separating "carries the enzyme family" from "exports it". Methanogenesis routes are called from gene gates together with a lineage policy in which every rule carries a literature source, so anaerobic methane and alkane oxidisers, and known methylotrophs, do not receive routes their lineage cannot support.

Validation: 1,401 metagenome-assembled genomes from 134 anaerobic digesters (no methanogenesis route in any of 1,361 non-methanogens), 3,043 GTDB species representatives across 203 phyla, and an assertion-based smoke test on seven reference proteomes.

Code MIT, curated panel CC BY 4.0.
